name: Inertia Tilt Scroll
description: Full-height scroll gallery where full-viewport images tilt in 3D and slide sideways as they cross the screen, following the scroll with eased inertia over a patterned background.
contents: Two-column grid of full-height image panels (single column on screens 760px and below)
Patterned background image with a base color
behavior: Internal scroll container drives a fixed image grid through an eased translateY
Each image gets random per-image rotateX and rotateY that flatten to zero as it reaches the viewport center
On desktop, left column images slide in from the left and right column images from the right
Smoothing runs on requestAnimationFrame and stops once the position settles
editableByProps: Column gap, scroll smoothing and tilt ranges
Slide distance, background color and background image

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the breakpoint where the layout collapses to one column
needsCodeEdit.where: 760 comparisons in setupAnimation and updateAnimationImages and the media query in the style block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the perspective depth of the tilt
needsCodeEdit.where: perspective(500px) in the setTransform call inside updateAnimationImages

fixed: Component is a 100vh internal scroll container, not the page scroll
Image grid is fixed-position and moved by JS to fake scrolling
Animation props are read at mount, remount with a key to apply changes
Tilt angles are randomized per image on mount
Total scroll length equals one viewport height per row of images
